titles.title: For Us and This World, This Would Be A Good Ending
This is a Good Ending and The End of the World
This is a Good End of the World
This Is the End of the World

description:
Jian was unfairly cut off at work, his lover met someone else, and he was even rejected by his family for saying he likes men. He is about to dive into the sea, cursing this damn world, but someone  
grabs him and tell him some strange things.

"The end of the world is coming soon.  
So let's live with him until then- okay?  
As the world will perish one way or another.  
Let's live as if there is no tomorrow!"

Jian and Geon's life in the world for a good enough ending begins!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/end_/?p_id=tw1277), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/845038122), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9956613), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/good_enough_end)

***Note:**  
The title is more complex, it technically means it's a good ending to "them" and also to the world*
